name: shapes
rows: elliptical sections that turn and taper

name: zm
expr: choose(shape, if(lampOn, (bulbH + H) / 2, H / 2), H / 2, (H - 2 * Dz) / 2, (H - 2 * Dz) / 2)

name: gVase
expr: if(2 * bmin^2 > e^2, (sqrt(2 * bmin^2 - e^2) - e) / 2, 0 mm)

name: gEv
expr: if(8 * Kell > w^2, (sqrt(8 * Kell - w^2) - w) / 4, 0 mm)

name: g
expr: choose(shape, gVase, min(gEh, gEv), A0 - e, A0 - e)

name: gNeed
expr: max(sp, if(lampOn, 22 mm - w / 2 + 2 * sp, 0 mm))

name: widthMin
expr: max(100 mm, choose(shape, 2 * bNeed / (rb * minS), 2 * max(bNeed, sqrt(((4 * gNeed + w)^2 + w^2) / 8 / (1 - (Wv / Cz)^2))), 2 * (gNeed + e), 2 * (gNeed + e)))

name: nMin
expr: if(lampOn, max(3, ceil(2 * g / max(1 mm, g + w / 2 - 22 mm)) + 1), 3)

name: aox
expr: if(mod(nXe, 2) == 1, ceil(qL / px) * px, (ceil(qL / px - 0.5) + 0.5) * px) + w / 2

name: aoy
expr: if(mod(nYe, 2) == 1, ceil(qL / py) * py, (ceil(qL / py - 0.5) + 0.5) * py) + w / 2

name: every crossing: X slot from the top down to the meeting plane
every crossing: Y slot from the foot up to the meeting plane
the two half-slots of a crossing meet
X slots are sheet + clearance wide
Y slots are sheet + clearance wide
web round the X slots at least 2 x sheet
web round the Y slots at least 2 x sheet
shape
label: Shape
description: The shape the slices show (table shapes)

name: width
label: Width
description: Overall width in x and y (the vase's widest diameter). Its least follows the sheet, the shape and the lamp room: room for three slices with webs of two sheet thicknesses

name: nx
label: X slices
description: Number of slices across x. The model uses at most as many as leave a web of two sheet thicknesses between the slots (fewer on a small shape or a thick sheet; the count assertions say how many), and with the lamp room at least enough for a slice beside the room

name: ny
label: Y slices
description: Number of slices across y, limited as the X slices are

name: sheet
label: Sheet
description: Material and thickness of the sheet (table sheets)

name: clearance
label: Slot clearance
description: Slot width = sheet thickness + clearance. Laser: the kerf widens the slots too; 0.1 to 0.2 mm slides on plywood

name: twist
label: Twist
description: Vase: how far the sections turn from the foot to the rim

name: ratio
label: Section ratio
description: Vase: the short axis of the elliptical section, in % of the long one (100: round)

name: waist
label: Waist
description: Vase: how far the middle narrows, in % (negative: a belly)

name: lamp
label: Lamp room
description: Vase: a square opening in the foot for an E27 lamp holder (40 mm ring) and the bulb

name: bulbD
label: Lamp room width
description: Least width of the opening: 44 mm passes the 40 mm holder ring; 64 mm an A60 bulb. It snaps outward to the slots of the slices beside it, and is at most what leaves a slice outside it

name: bulbH
label: Lamp room height
description: Height of the opening from the foot

name: relief
label: Relief
description: Saddle and wave: how far the top rises and falls, in % of the height; at most what keeps two webs under the lowest point and slopes of at most 1.5 (a tall, narrow shape gets less)

title: Sliceform
description: A sliceform lamp shade or sculpture: two families of flat slices that slide into each other with half-lap slots and together show a shape from a formula. Choose the shape (a twisted vase or lamp shade, an ellipsoid or sphere, a saddle, a wave), its size, the number of slices each way, the sheet and the slot clearance; the vase can have a room in its foot for an E27 lamp holder. Every outline is the exact section of the shape. To cut it: File > Export..., SVG or DXF with the face set "Cut sheet" (file.export {"path": "sliceform.svg", "set": "Cut sheet", "width": "600 mm"}); each slice is on a layer named after it (X1, X2, ... and Y1, Y2, ...).
